recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有數個大型組織球，胞質豐富淡藍色、呈細纖維狀條紋，像「揉皺的衛生紙（wrinkled tissue paper）」，細胞核小而偏位，這是 Gaucher 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Large histiocytes, several times the size of surrounding cells, forming a loose cluster
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
Small, round to oval, eccentrically placed nuclei with coarse chromatin
No discrete vacuoles or foamy bubbly cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cell-like cells and myeloid precursors in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large macrophages with abundant pale blue, fibrillary cytoplasm imparting a wrinkled tissue-paper appearance, and small eccentric nuclei. The cytoplasm lacks the discrete vacuoles of foamy histiocytes. Background hematopoietic and lymphoid cells are unremarkable in this field. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; confirmation by leukocyte glucocerebrosidase activity and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar striated histiocytes arising from high cell turnover; distinguished by the underlying disorder and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Cytoplasm is finely vacuolated and bubbly ('mulberry') rather than fibrillary and striated.
Striated cytoplasm contains negative-image rods and is acid-fast positive.
